lines.text: Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon besieged Jerusalem, and the Lord delivered Jehoiakim into his hand, with articles from God's house.
Ashpenaz was ordered to bring in young Israelites to be trained for three years and fed the royal food.
Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah were renamed, and Daniel resolved not to defile himself with the king's food.
Daniel asked the steward for a twenty-day test on vegetables and water, and the four looked healthier afterward.
The king found the four ten times better than all the magicians and enchanters in his kingdom, so they entered his service.
